title: AI Solutions Architect
description: Claim Pilot: Built expense claim intake through Teams and WhatsApp, document capture in a web portal, and claimant, verifier and approver reviews. Implemented Gemini receipt extraction, a FastAPI backend and React portal, with accounting/ERP integration for invoices and general ledger journals.

Trade Pilot: Developed WhatsApp intake for purchase orders, delivery orders and item lists from messages, images, PDFs and Excel files. Combined document extraction with a Next.js review portal and AutoCount/Dynamod integration for quotations, sales orders and goods received notes, supporting admin review or automatic processing.

WareBot: Delivered a conversational AI assistant for Warehouse Management System with natural-language stock queries, warehouse operations, SSE streaming and explicit confirmation before writes. Integrated locally hosted Qwen3.5 inference and delivered three Maestro UI test flows and a 21-assertion Newman API suite.

Smart HVAC Catalogue System: Built a RAG backend matching air-conditioners to room type, size and usage. Combined PDF ingestion, dense and sparse retrieval, and product filters; implemented asynchronous ingestion, LLM evaluation and observability, with tests and evaluations in GitHub Actions.

Agentic AI Layer: Architected multi-channel agents connecting accounting and business systems through APIs and role-restricted MCP tools. Implemented Claude Agent SDK workflows, Gemini-backed memory, Pipecat voice, and Telegram/WhatsApp access; integrated Google Workspace and Microsoft Graph using OAuth with PKCE and encrypted token storage.
Agent First Web Audit: Developed a pipeline of four agent skills to audit websites for AI readiness, apply fixes and review changes.
AI Enablement: Conducted company-wide training for functional consultants, engineers and support teams, plus monthly AI Ask Me Anything sessions for practical sharing and Q&A.
